question: 各学院在读学生人数是多少？
sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, COUNT(s.id) AS student_count FROM student s JOIN college c ON s.college_id = c.id WHERE s.status = 'active' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY student_count DESC

question: 2025 年春季学期挂科率最高的 5 门课程是什么？
sql: SELECT c.name AS course_name, AVG(CASE WHEN sc.final_score < 60 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS fail_rate, COUNT(e.id) AS enrollment_count FROM score sc JOIN enrollment e ON sc.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN teaching_class tc ON e.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN course c ON tc.course_id = c.id WHERE tc.year = 2025 AND tc.semester = 'spring' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(e.id) > 0 ORDER BY fail_rate DESC, enrollment_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: 哪些课程的作业提交率最低？
sql: SELECT c.name AS course_name, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.status <> 'missing' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS submit_rate, COUNT(s.id) AS submission_count FROM assignment_submission s JOIN assignment a ON s.assignment_id = a.id JOIN teaching_class tc ON a.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN course c ON tc.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY submit_rate ASC, submission_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: 按课程统计缺勤率最高的前 10 门课。
sql: SELECT c.name AS course_name, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN a.status = 'absent' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS absent_rate, COUNT(a.id) AS attendance_count FROM attendance a JOIN teaching_class tc ON a.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN course c ON tc.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY absent_rate DESC, attendance_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各课程的学习活跃度和平均分有什么关系？
sql: SELECT c.name AS course_name, SUM(la.login_count + la.resource_views + la.discussion_posts) AS activity_score, ROUND(AVG(sc.final_score), 2) AS avg_final_score FROM learning_activity la JOIN teaching_class tc ON la.teaching_class_id = tc.id JOIN course c ON tc.course_id = c.id JOIN enrollment e ON e.teaching_class_id = tc.id AND e.student_id = la.student_id JOIN score sc ON sc.enrollment_id = e.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY activity_score DESC LIMIT 10

question: 哪些专业的未解除学业预警人数最多？
sql: SELECT m.name AS major_name, COUNT(w.id) AS warning_count, ROUND(AVG(w.risk_score), 1) AS avg_risk_score FROM academic_warning w JOIN student s ON w.student_id = s.id JOIN major m ON s.major_id = m.id WHERE w.resolved = 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY warning_count DESC, avg_risk_score DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各学院获得奖助金额总额是多少？
sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, COUNT(sh.id) AS scholarship_count, SUM(sh.amount) AS total_amount FROM scholarship sh JOIN student s ON sh.student_id = s.id JOIN college c ON s.college_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC
